repairs.quote: Passive: Yunara deal (5/10/15/20/25 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit and attacking grants 1 Unleash (2 Unleash for champions). Active: Yunara consumes 8 Unleash and for 5 seconds gains 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed and deals an additional (5/10/15/20/25 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit. During this time, her Attacks spread to nearby enemies dealing them (30% Attack Damage) physical damage. Transcendent State: This Ability is instantly activated for 15 seconds. Spread Attacks can Strike Critically and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness. Damage from spread Attacks deal 250% damage to minions below 30% Health.

proposalDecisions.reason: 초월진입 transform 사건에서 즉시15초활성화하도록 공격에서 분리.
On-Hit30%효율을 attack_modifier의 other역할로 분리.250%와체력30%를 혼동하지 않는다.
